recap.narration_text: Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: state. license. must. A Louisiana resident who drives on the state’s public streets or highways needs a Louisiana driver license. Keep your driver license with you whenever you drive. When an officer asks to inspect your driver license, you must show it.

Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: must. originals. certified. Louisiana licenses and identification cards must use the applicant’s complete legal name. Identity papers must be originals or copies certified by the department that keeps the record. A photocopy is not acceptable identification even when a notary has certified it.

Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: seventeen. must. domiciliary. For an applicant aged seventeen or younger, a custodial parent or legal guardian must sign for license issuance, duplicate issuance and restriction changes. Both the minor applicant and the parent or guardian must present identification. When parents have joint custody, only the domiciliary parent may sign the minor’s application.
